mentions.author: chroma
mentions.story: Opening the North American charging standard
mentions.why: Test showing unreliable non-Tesla charging infrastructure.
mentions.quote: When MKBHD tested a Tesla and a Mustang Mach-E, the Mach-E itself was fine but the charging infrastructure was unreliable.

mentions.author: ggreer
mentions.why: Experiment comparing a 1,000 mile trip in EV versus gas.
mentions.quote: A 1,000 mile road trip in a Tesla is about 8% slower than a gas car.
